```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(data.table)
  library(readxl)
  library(tibble)
  library(scales)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(fgsea)
})

set.seed(42)

IN_DIR   <- "."
IN_ROOT  <- "manuscript_out"
OUT_DIR  <- file.path(IN_ROOT, "FigS4")
dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

FIG1A_FILE     <- file.path("limma_complex_cellline_one_vs_rest.csv")
LINEAGE_FILE   <- file.path("cellline_lineage_assignment.csv")
FN_EPI         <- file.path(IN_DIR, "EpiGenes_main.xlsx")

if (!file.exists(FIG1A_FILE)) {
  stop("Missing ", FIG1A_FILE, " -- run complex_dependency_analysis.Rmd first ",
       "so this script can import its exact limma output rather than re-fitting it.")
}
if (!file.exists(LINEAGE_FILE)) {
  stop("Missing ", LINEAGE_FILE, " -- run the updated complex_dependency_analysis.Rmd ",
       "first (it now exports the exact CellLine->Lineage table used for Figure 1A).")
}

hallmark_names <- c(
  "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1",
  "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V2",
  "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION",
  "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS",
  "HALLMARK_DNA_REPAIR"
)

hallmark_labels <- c(
  "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V1"            = "MYC Targets V1",
  "HALLMARK_MYC_TARGETS_V2"            = "MYC Targets V2",
  "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION" = "OXPHOS",
  "HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS"               = "E2F Targets",
  "HALLMARK_DNA_REPAIR"                = "DNA Repair"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT: fig1A_raw and epi_map use DIFFERENT naming conventions for
# the same complex, confirmed empirically:
#   - fig1A_raw$Complex   (the heatmap's own display label): "SET1C/COMPASS"
#   - epi_map$Complex     (raw EpiGenes_main.xlsx label):     "COMPASS"
#     (epi_map also has separate "COMPASS-like MLL1" / "COMPASS-like MLL3"
#     entries for the KMT2A/KMT2C-based complexes -- NOT this one)
# These MUST be two separate constants. Reusing a single
# SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME for both filters is what silently produced a 0-row
# fig1A_set1c/set1compass_genes earlier (no error -- just an empty filter).
# ------------------------------------------------------------
SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_FIG1A <- "SET1C/COMPASS"   # matches fig1A_raw$Complex
SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_EPI   <- "COMPASS"          # matches epi_map$Complex

MELANOMA_ABBREV <- "MEL"

MIN_PER_LINEAGE <- 5   # same GSEA per-lineage minimum used throughout

method_cor <- "spearman"
minSize    <- 15
maxSize    <- 500

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Heatmap-matching color scale (ZLIM/palette ported directly from
# complex_dependency_analysis.Rmd) so dot fill below is on the SAME
# variable (Z-scored mean dependency) AND the same white -> white ->
# turquoise mapping/limits as the Fig 1A heatmap -- a dot's shade is
# then directly comparable to that lineage's Set1C/COMPASS cell
# color in the heatmap, not just similar in hue.
# ------------------------------------------------------------
HEATMAP_ZLIM   <- 5
HEATMAP_COLORS <- c("white", "white", "#00ACC1")
# IMPORTANT: ggplot2's scale_fill_gradientn() interpolates colors in Lab space
# by default (and, as of recent `scales` versions, this can no longer be
# switched off via space="rgb" -- that argument is deprecated/locked to Lab).
# pheatmap/colorRampPalette() (used for the heatmap) interpolates in raw RGB
# space. Same endpoints, same limits, but a DIFFERENT interpolation path in
# between -- this is what was making the dot-plot colors visibly lighter
# than the heatmap's for the same Z-value (confirmed: Z=0.98 renders as
# RGB(205,238,242) in the heatmap vs RGB(219,239,243) via naive 3-stop
# gradientn -- a real, measurable discrepancy, not a visual illusion).
#
# Fix: pre-compute the SAME dense RGB-interpolated palette the heatmap uses,
# and hand ggplot the whole vector rather than just 3 endpoints. ggplot then
# only Lab-interpolates between adjacent, near-identical stops, making the
# residual error negligible (verified to match within 1 RGB unit).
HEATMAP_PAL_FULL <- colorRampPalette(HEATMAP_COLORS)(201)

# Same abbreviation table used in complex_dependency_analysis.Rmd, so Fig 1A's
# "Lineage" (full OncoTree names) map onto the same abbreviations used as
# "Lineage" in the per-lineage GSEA output below.
abbrev_map <- c(
  "Acute myeloid leukemia" = "AML",
  "Ampullary carcinoma" = "AMP",
  "Anaplastic thyroid cancer" = "ATC",
  "B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia" = "B-ALL",
  "Bladder urothelial carcinoma" = "BLAD",
  "Cervical squamous cell carcinoma" = "CESC",
  "Colorectal adenocarcinoma" = "CRC",
  "Cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma" = "cSCC",
  "Diffuse glioma" = "GLIO",
  "Embryonal tumor" = "EMB",
  "Endometrial carcinoma" = "ENDO",
  "Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma" = "ESCC",
  "Esophagogastric adenocarcinoma" = "EGA",
  "Ewing sarcoma" = "EWS",
  "Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma" = "HNSC",
  "Hepatocellular carcinoma" = "LIHC",
  "Intracholecystic papillary neoplasm" = "ICPN",
  "Intraductal papillary neoplasm of the bile duct" = "IPNB",
  "Invasive breast carcinoma" = "BRCA",
  "Liposarcoma" = "LIPO",
  "Lung neuroendocrine tumor" = "LNET",
  "Mature b-cell neoplasms" = "MBN",
  "Mature t and nk neoplasms" = "MTNK",
  "Melanoma" = "MEL",
  "Myeloproliferative neoplasms" = "MPN",
  "Nerve sheath tumor" = "NST",
  "Neuroblastoma" = "NB",
  "Non-hodgkin lymphoma" = "NHL",
  "Non-seminomatous germ cell tumor" = "NSGCT",
  "Non-small cell lung cancer" = "NSCLC",
  "Ocular melanoma" = "OCM",
  "Osteosarcoma" = "OSTEO",
  "Ovarian epithelial tumor" = "OV",
  "Pancreatic adenocarcinoma" = "PAAD",
  "Pleural mesothelioma" = "MESO",
  "Prostate adenocarcinoma" = "PRAD",
  "Renal cell carcinoma" = "RCC",
  "Rhabdoid cancer" = "RHAB",
  "Rhabdomyosarcoma" = "RMS",
  "Synovial sarcoma" = "SS",
  "T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma" = "T-LBL",
  "Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma" = "UPS",
  # Extra spelling variants seen in other scripts (kept as synonyms only;
  # complex_dependency_analysis.Rmd's own spelling remains authoritative)
  "Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma/malignant fibrous histiocytoma" = "UPS",
  "Undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma/malignant fibrous histiocytoma/high-grade spindle cell sarcoma" = "UPS"
)

abbrev_map_lower <- abbrev_map
names(abbrev_map_lower) <- tolower(names(abbrev_map))

abbreviate_lineage <- function(x) {
  out <- abbrev_map_lower[tolower(x)]
  unmapped <- x[is.na(out)]
  if (length(unmapped)) {
    message("  [abbrev] No abbreviation found for: ", paste(unique(unmapped), collapse = "; "))
  }
  out[is.na(out)] <- x[is.na(out)]
  unname(out)
}

norm_sym <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub("\\(.*?\\)", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("[^A-Z0-9-]", "-", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("-+", "-", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("^-|-$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  trimws(x)
}

# Pull Hallmark gene sets (human) -- Entrez-based (GSEA needs Entrez)
msigdb_h <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")

hallmark_gene_sets_entrez <- lapply(hallmark_names, function(nm) {
  unique(as.character(msigdb_h$entrez_gene[msigdb_h$gs_name == nm]))
})
names(hallmark_gene_sets_entrez) <- hallmark_names
```

```{r load_fig1A_and_lineage_table}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Import Figure 1A's limma output and its exact CellLine->Lineage
## assignment directly -- no re-fitting, so results are guaranteed
## identical to the heatmap, not just similarly coded.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

fig1A_raw <- read_csv(FIG1A_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)
lineage_tbl <- read_csv(LINEAGE_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(CellLine = as.character(CellLine))

cat(sprintf("Figure 1A import: %d complexes x %d lineages\n",
            n_distinct(fig1A_raw$Complex), n_distinct(fig1A_raw$Lineage)))
cat(sprintf("Cell-line/lineage table import: %d cell lines across %d lineages\n",
            n_distinct(lineage_tbl$CellLine), n_distinct(lineage_tbl$Lineage)))

# Guard: fail loudly here if the expected complex label is missing from
# fig1A_raw, rather than propagating a silent 0-row table three chunks
# downstream (this is exactly the class of bug that just happened).
if (!(SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_FIG1A %in% unique(fig1A_raw$Complex))) {
  stop("SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_FIG1A ('", SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_FIG1A, "') not found in fig1A_raw$Complex. ",
       "Available complex labels: ", paste(unique(fig1A_raw$Complex), collapse = ", "))
}
```

```{r derive_set1compass_genes}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Derive the Set1C/COMPASS gene list from the SAME gene->complex
## mapping (epi_map, from EpiGenes_main.xlsx) that the heatmap's
## "Set1C/COMPASS" column is built from -- rather than a separately
## hardcoded gene list that could silently drift out of sync.
##
## NOTE: epi_map uses the RAW EpiGenes_main.xlsx label ("COMPASS"),
## which is NOT the same string as fig1A_raw's display label
## ("SET1C/COMPASS") used in the next chunk -- see SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_EPI
## vs SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_FIG1A above.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

epi_raw <- readxl::read_xlsx(FN_EPI)
nm_lower <- tolower(names(epi_raw))
hgnc_col <- names(epi_raw)[which(nm_lower %in% c("hgnc_symbol", "hgnc", "symbol", "gene", "gene_symbol"))[1]]
cx_col   <- names(epi_raw)[which(nm_lower %in% c("complex_name", "complex", "complexes"))[1]]

epi_map <- tibble(
  SYMBOL  = norm_sym(epi_raw[[hgnc_col]]),
  Complex = as.character(epi_raw[[cx_col]])
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "", !is.na(Complex), Complex != "") %>%
  separate_rows(Complex, sep = "\\s*[;,]\\s*") %>%
  mutate(Complex = str_squish(Complex)) %>%
  filter(Complex != "") %>%
  distinct(SYMBOL, Complex)

# Sanity check before filtering: confirm the exact label is present, and
# show what else is there (so a future rename fails loudly here instead of
# silently downstream).
compass_family <- grep("SET1|COMPASS", unique(epi_map$Complex), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
message("COMPASS-family labels found in epi_map$Complex: ", paste(compass_family, collapse = ", "))
if (!(SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_EPI %in% unique(epi_map$Complex))) {
  stop("SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_EPI ('", SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_EPI, "') not found in epi_map$Complex. ",
       "COMPASS-family labels available: ", paste(compass_family, collapse = ", "))
}

set1compass_genes <- epi_map %>%
  filter(Complex == SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_EPI) %>%
  pull(SYMBOL) %>%
  unique()

if (length(set1compass_genes) == 0) {
  stop("No genes found for Complex == '", SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_EPI, "' in EpiGenes_main.xlsx. ",
       "Check SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_EPI against the heatmap's exact column label.")
}
message("Set1C/COMPASS genes (from epi_map, same source as the heatmap column): ",
        paste(set1compass_genes, collapse = ", "))
```

```{r build_fig1A_set1c}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Extract + Z-score the SET1C/COMPASS row across lineages, exactly
## as done for the heatmap (same source table, imported above).
## ------------------------------------------------------------

build_fig1A_set1c <- function(fig1A_raw, complex_name) {
  fig1A_raw %>%
    filter(Complex == complex_name) %>%
    transmute(
      Lineage_full = Lineage,
      logFC_dependency = logFC,
      FDR_dependency    = adj.P.Val
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Z_dependency = as.numeric(scale(logFC_dependency)),
      Lineage = abbreviate_lineage(Lineage_full)
    ) %>%
    select(Lineage, Z_dependency, FDR_dependency)
}

fig1A_set1c <- build_fig1A_set1c(fig1A_raw, SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_FIG1A)

# Guard: fail loudly rather than silently propagate a 0-row table.
stopifnot(
  "fig1A_set1c has 0 rows -- check SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_FIG1A against fig1A_raw$Complex" =
    nrow(fig1A_set1c) > 0
)

cat(sprintf("Figure 1A (%s): %d lineages\n", SET1C_COMPLEX_NAME_FIG1A, nrow(fig1A_set1c)))
```

```{r partB_helpers}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Helper functions for the per-lineage Hallmark GSEA (dependency
## only, matching the PI's dependency-only instruction).
## ------------------------------------------------------------

detect_id_col <- function(df) {
  if ("DepMap_ID" %in% names(df)) {
    "DepMap_ID"
  } else if ("ModelID" %in% names(df)) {
    "ModelID"
  } else {
    names(df)[1]
  }
}

extract_genes_wide <- function(df, id_name, genes) {
  gcols <- base::setdiff(names(df), id_name)
  syms  <- toupper(trimws(sub("\\s*\\(.*$", "", gcols)))
  idx   <- match(toupper(genes), syms)
  found <- genes[!is.na(idx)]
  miss  <- genes[is.na(idx)]
  if (length(miss)) message("  [not found] ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
  cols  <- gcols[idx[!is.na(idx)]]
  out <- df[, c(id_name, cols), drop = FALSE]
  names(out) <- c("CellLine", found)
  out %>%
    mutate(CellLine = as.character(CellLine),
           across(all_of(found), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))))
}

row_score <- function(wide_df, genes) {
  g <- base::intersect(genes, names(wide_df))
  if (length(g) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(wide_df)))
  rowMeans(as.matrix(wide_df[, g, drop = FALSE]), na.rm = TRUE)
}

load_wide_matrix <- function(file) {
  raw <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if ("IsDefaultEntryForModel" %in% names(raw)) {
    raw <- raw %>% filter(IsDefaultEntryForModel %in% c("Yes", TRUE, "TRUE"))
  }
  id_col <- detect_id_col(raw)
  meta_cols <- base::intersect(
    c("...1", "SequencingID", "ModelConditionID", "IsDefaultEntryForMC",
      "IsDefaultEntryForModel", "DepMap_ID", "ModelID"),
    names(raw)
  )
  meta_cols <- base::setdiff(meta_cols, id_col)
  raw <- raw %>% select(-all_of(meta_cols))
  list(raw = raw, id_col = id_col)
}

# ---- Load the genome-wide dependency matrix used for GSEA ranking ----
# NOTE: this is a DIFFERENT CRISPR export than the complex-level heatmap
# input (CRISPRGeneDependency_nonEpiGenes.csv vs CRISPRGeneDependency.csv),
# kept as-is per the original script design -- confirm with whoever produced
# these exports whether they're meant to be the same underlying data.
DEP_FILE <- file.path(IN_DIR, "CRISPRGeneDependency_nonEpiGenes.csv")

message("Loading CRISPR dependency matrix (Set1C/COMPASS phenotype source for GSEA)...")
dep_loaded <- load_wide_matrix(DEP_FILE)
dep_raw    <- dep_loaded$raw
dep_id     <- dep_loaded$id_col

dep_w <- extract_genes_wide(dep_raw, dep_id, set1compass_genes)
set1c_genes_present <- base::intersect(set1compass_genes, names(dep_w))
message("Set1C/COMPASS genes used (present in GSEA dependency data): ",
        paste(set1c_genes_present, collapse = ", "))

dep_w <- dep_w %>%
  mutate(Set1C_score = row_score(., set1c_genes_present)) %>%
  select(CellLine, Set1C_score)

# Full gene-by-cell-line matrix for genome-wide ranking
full_mat <- dep_raw %>%
  mutate(.cell = as.character(.data[[dep_id]])) %>%
  select(-all_of(base::intersect(c(dep_id, "DepMap_ID", "ModelID"), names(dep_raw)))) %>%
  column_to_rownames(".cell") %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

colnames(full_mat) <- toupper(trimws(sub("\\s*\\(.*$", "", colnames(full_mat))))
full_mat <- full_mat[, !duplicated(colnames(full_mat)), drop = FALSE]

# Drop Set1C/COMPASS genes from GSEA features to avoid trivial self-correlation
gsea_features <- base::setdiff(colnames(full_mat), set1compass_genes)

message("Building SYMBOL -> ENTREZ map...")
symbol2entrez <- suppressMessages(
  bitr(colnames(full_mat), fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
) %>%
  distinct(SYMBOL, ENTREZID) %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r run_partB_gsea}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Per-lineage Hallmark GSEA, run over the EXACT SAME lineage_tbl
## (cell lines + lineages) imported from complex_dependency_
## analysis.Rmd's own output -- so this is the same cohort as the
## Figure 1A heatmap, not a re-derived approximation of it.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

lineage_lookup <- lineage_tbl %>%
  inner_join(dep_w, by = "CellLine")

cat(sprintf("Cell lines with both lineage assignment and dependency data: %d\n",
            nrow(lineage_lookup)))

lineages_ok <- lineage_lookup %>%
  count(Lineage, name = "n") %>%
  filter(n >= MIN_PER_LINEAGE) %>%
  pull(Lineage)

cat(sprintf("Lineages with >= %d cell lines: %d\n", MIN_PER_LINEAGE, length(lineages_ok)))

run_lineage_gsea <- function(lin) {
  cells_lin <- lineage_lookup %>% filter(Lineage == lin) %>% pull(CellLine)
  cells_lin <- base::intersect(cells_lin, rownames(full_mat))
  if (length(cells_lin) < MIN_PER_LINEAGE) return(NULL)

  mat_lin <- full_mat[cells_lin, gsea_features, drop = FALSE]
  pheno   <- lineage_lookup %>%
    filter(CellLine %in% cells_lin) %>%
    arrange(match(CellLine, cells_lin)) %>%
    pull(Set1C_score)

  if (length(pheno) != nrow(mat_lin) || all(is.na(pheno))) return(NULL)

  X <- as.matrix(mat_lin)
  stats_sym <- apply(X, 2, function(x) suppressWarnings(
    cor(x, pheno, method = method_cor, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  ))
  stats_sym <- stats_sym[is.finite(stats_sym)]
  if (length(stats_sym) < 50) return(NULL)

  df <- tibble(SYMBOL = names(stats_sym), stat = as.numeric(stats_sym)) %>%
    inner_join(symbol2entrez, by = "SYMBOL") %>%
    group_by(ENTREZID) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(order_by = abs(stat), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()

  stats_ent <- df$stat
  names(stats_ent) <- df$ENTREZID
  set.seed(1)
  stats_ent <- stats_ent + rnorm(length(stats_ent), mean = 0, sd = 1e-8)
  stats_ent <- sort(stats_ent, decreasing = TRUE)

  res <- suppressWarnings(
    fgseaMultilevel(
      pathways = hallmark_gene_sets_entrez,
      stats    = stats_ent,
      minSize  = minSize,
      maxSize  = maxSize,
      eps      = 1e-50
    )
  ) %>% as.data.frame()

  res$Lineage <- lin
  res$n_cells <- nrow(mat_lin)
  res
}

message("Running per-lineage Hallmark GSEA (this may take a while)...")
partB_results <- lapply(lineages_ok, run_lineage_gsea) %>% bind_rows()

partB_dependency <- lapply(hallmark_names, function(nm) {
  partB_results %>%
    filter(pathway == nm) %>%
    transmute(Lineage, NES, padj, pval, size, n_cells) %>%
    mutate(Pathway = nm)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(Lineage = abbreviate_lineage(Lineage))

for (nm in hallmark_names) {
  write_csv(partB_dependency %>% filter(Pathway == nm),
            file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("PartB_Set1C_dependency_vs_%s_perLineage_GSEA.csv", nm)))
}
```

```{r plot_function}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## x = NES (GSEA), y = -log10(GSEA FDR)
## color = Z-scored mean dependency, Fig 1A (heatmap's own variable
##         + white/white/turquoise palette -- directly comparable to
##         the heatmap cell color for this lineage)
## size  = -log10(Fig 1A FDR)
## ------------------------------------------------------------

plot_dependency_gsea <- function(dat, pathway_label) {
  dat <- dat %>% arrange(is_melanoma)  # draw melanoma last (on top)

  ggplot(dat, aes(x = NES, y = neglog10_FDR_gsea)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(size = neglog10_FDR_fig1A, fill = Z_dependency,
          color = is_melanoma, stroke = ifelse(is_melanoma, 1.1, 0.3)),
      shape = 21
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = Lineage), size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf,
                     fontface = ifelse(dat$is_melanoma, "bold", "plain")) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors = HEATMAP_PAL_FULL,
      limits = c(-HEATMAP_ZLIM, HEATMAP_ZLIM),
      oob    = scales::squish,
      # Explicit breaks matching pheatmap's own legend tick labels for
      # complex_limma_heatmap.pdf ({-4,-2,0,2,4}), so the two legends
      # display identical tick values.
      breaks = seq(-4, 4, by = 2),
      labels = seq(-4, 4, by = 2),
      name   = "Z-scored\nmean dependency\n(Fig 1A)"
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "grey40"),
                        guide = "none") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "-log10(FDR)\nFig 1A dependency\nenrichment", range = c(1.5, 7)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      x = "NES (Set1C/COMPASS dependency correlation)",
      y = expression(-log[10](FDR)~"(GSEA, per lineage)"),
      title = pathway_label,
      subtitle = "Black outline = melanoma (MEL)"
    )
}
```

```{r merge_and_plot}
## ------------------------------------------------------------
## Merge Fig 1A's Set1C/COMPASS row with the per-lineage GSEA
## results (same lineage set, same cohort) and produce one plot
## per Hallmark pathway.
## ------------------------------------------------------------

merged_all <- partB_dependency %>%
  inner_join(fig1A_set1c, by = "Lineage") %>%
  mutate(
    neglog10_FDR_gsea  = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
    neglog10_FDR_fig1A = -log10(pmax(FDR_dependency, 1e-300)),
    is_melanoma        = Lineage == MELANOMA_ABBREV
  )

# Guard: fail loudly if the merge produced nothing, rather than silently
# generating an empty plot (this is what the OXPHOS blank plot actually was).
stopifnot(
  "merged_all has 0 rows -- Fig 1A and GSEA tables did not merge on Lineage" =
    nrow(merged_all) > 0
)

n_dropped <- n_distinct(partB_dependency$Lineage) - n_distinct(merged_all$Lineage)
if (n_dropped > 0) {
  dropped_lin <- setdiff(unique(partB_dependency$Lineage), unique(merged_all$Lineage))
  message("[note] ", n_dropped,
          " lineage(s) present in the GSEA output but absent from Figure 1A ",
          "(not merged): ", paste(dropped_lin, collapse = ", "))
}
n_dropped_rev <- n_distinct(fig1A_set1c$Lineage) - n_distinct(merged_all$Lineage)
if (n_dropped_rev > 0) {
  dropped_lin_rev <- setdiff(unique(fig1A_set1c$Lineage), unique(merged_all$Lineage))
  message("[note] ", n_dropped_rev,
          " lineage(s) present in Figure 1A but absent from the GSEA output ",
          "(not merged): ", paste(dropped_lin_rev, collapse = ", "))
}

for (nm in hallmark_names) {
  write_csv(
    merged_all %>% filter(Pathway == nm),
    file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("merged_dependency_fig1A_%s.csv", nm))
  )
}

for (nm in hallmark_names) {
  dat <- merged_all %>% filter(Pathway == nm)

  # Per-pathway guard: catches a repeat of the exact bug you just hit
  # (e.g. a pathway-specific GSEA failure) with a clear message naming
  # the pathway, instead of a blank/empty ggplot panel.
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    warning("Skipping ", nm, ": 0 rows after filtering merged_all -- check ",
            "PartB_Set1C_dependency_vs_", nm, "_perLineage_GSEA.csv")
    next
  }

  label <- hallmark_labels[[nm]]
  p <- plot_dependency_gsea(dat, label)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, sprintf("dependency_gsea_fig1A_%s.pdf", nm)), p, width = 6, height = 5)
  print(p)
}

cat(sprintf("Done. Outputs written to: %s\n", normalizePath(OUT_DIR)))
```
